cd /workspace && grep -n "CMAKE_C_FLAGS\|sanitize\|CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS" repo-vul/work-vul/build/CMakeCache.txt | head -80 && cat > /workspace/driver.cc <<'EOF'
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <vector>
#include <fstream>
extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size);
int main(int argc,char**argv){ if(argc<2) return 2; std::ifstream f(argv[1], std::ios::binary); std::vector<uint8_t> d((std::istreambuf_iterator<char>(f)),{}); return LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(d.data(), d.size()); }
EOF
